declarations.name: users
declarations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',avatar_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(datetime('now')));

declarations.name: notes_fts
declarations.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes_fts USING fts5(title,content,content='notes',content_rowid='rowid');

declarations.name: notes_ai
declarations.sql: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS notes_ai AFTER INSERT ON notes BEGIN INSERT INTO notes_fts(rowid,title,content)VALUES(NEW.rowid,NEW.title,NEW.content);END;

declarations.name: notes_ad
declarations.sql: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS notes_ad AFTER DELETE ON notes BEGIN INSERT INTO notes_fts(notes_fts,rowid,title,content)VALUES('delete',OLD.rowid,OLD.title,OLD.content);END;
